description.zh:
是否并发移除。

- true：节点将并发从伸缩组中被移除。

- false：节点将顺序从伸缩组中被移除。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove nodes concurrently.

- true: Nodes are concurrently removed from the scaling group.

- false: Nodes are sequentially removed from the scaling group.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
是否排水节点。可选值：
- true：排水。
- false：不排水。
description.en:
Specifies whether to drain the nodes. Valid values:
- true: Drain the nodes.
- false: Do not drain the nodes.

description.en:
Specifies whether to release the nodes. Valid values:

title.en: Remove nodes from a node pool

descriptions.zh:
- 移除节点涉及Pod迁移，可能会影响业务，请在业务低峰期操作。
- 操作过程中可能存在非预期风险，请提前做好相关的数据备份。
- 操作过程中，后台会把当前节点设置为不可调度状态。
-  移除节点仅移除Worker节点，不会移除Master节点。
 - 即使选择了释放节点（即`release_node`为`true`的节点），包年包月的节点也不会释放。需要您在移除节点后，通过[ECS控制台](https://ecs.console.aliyun.com/)操作释放。
descriptions.en:
- Removing nodes involves pod migration, which may affect your services. Perform this operation during off-peak hours.
- Unexpected risks may occur during the operation. Back up your data in advance.
- During the operation, the nodes being removed are set to the unschedulable state in the background.
- This operation removes only worker nodes, not master nodes.
 - Even if you choose to release nodes (nodes for which `release_node` is set to `true`), subscription nodes are not released. After removing the nodes, release them in the [ECS console](https://ecs.console.aliyun.com/).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs remove-node-pool-nodes --cluster-id c23421cfa74454bc8b37163fd19af0000 --nodepool-id np97de2cfb1ba042398dd8f5504c940000 --release-node true --drain-node true --nodes cn-hangzhou.172.16.xxx.xxx --instance-ids i-bp1c70fqbv1nlu9xxxxx --concurrency false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cs DELETE /clusters/c23421cfa74454bc8b37163fd19af0000/nodepools/np97de2cfb1ba042398dd8f5504c940000/nodes --region cn-hangzhou --release_node true --nodes '["cn-hangzhou.172.16.xxx.xxx"]' --instance_ids '["i-bp1c70fqbv1nlu9xxxxx"]' --drain_node true --concurrency false --header "Content-Type=application/json"
